name: sMYX dividend token transfer creates unbacked profit-per-share while shrinking recorded supply
summary: The unverified 2020 sMYX dividend contract 0x40432844506f3a51c266ecabad2beb23cad27f66 raises its profit-per-share accumulator by the transferred amount divided by total supply on every transfer, without any MYX inflow. Because of a reversed subtraction helper it also lowers the recorded supply by the transferred amount, so each transfer mints a larger unbacked dividend. The attacker flash-borrowed 3 WETH, bought MYX, and took a dominant sMYX position split across two contracts. It then alternated transfers between them with withdraw() calls and exited, draining 6.68M MYX of other holders' deposits.
notes: Direct unverified runtime with no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT and an empty EIP-1967 slot; its transaction history contains only buy, sell, withdraw, reinvest, transfer and exit calls, so deployment is the only code or configuration change.

sMYX's net MYX depletion in the exploit transaction, net of the attacker's own buy-in. MYX's transfer tax burned 1,049,377.107 MYX and sent 1,049,377.107 MYX to the MYX contract on the way out, and the remaining 4,576,539.435 MYX were sold into the MYX/WETH pair 0xe5437565cba444f33f40215afecc92e38e2d1ba9, whose net WETH depletion of 1.692074431746939187 is the realised value of the whole drained amount (a lower bound on holders' loss). The 0.009 WETH flash-swap fee is financing and not netted.
sMYX is unverified; the transfer accounting defect is established from the exploit trace and BlockSec's decompilation-based analysis, not from source.
